svg.text: Vertical section · host limb in cross-section · suspended (tension) connection · NO dimensions (design intent)
Host limb (live, sound, large-diameter) shown in cross-section — bark, living cambium ring, growth rings, pith
Cambium-saver sleeve (EPDM / felt-lined) — the ONLY element bearing on bark; wraps past where the sling leaves the limb
Wide polyester round sling, rigged as an open BASKET over B — near-vertical legs, demountable, never a choking ring
Steel thimble — protects sling fibres at the bend
Bolt-type (safety-pin) bow shackle — will not unscrew under dynamic load
Anti-spin swivel — frees occupant rotation, no torque into limb
Forged mast-top eye capping the Ø20 spire — engineered termination (replaces the 4-prong hook)
Redundant backup sling to a 2nd sound limb — life-safety
Basket seated against branch collar — anti-creep (no axial walk)
Live hardwood limb, ≥ ~150 mm dia at the grip; sound species only
Sited near (not on) a structurally sound union; NO co-dominant / included-bark fork
Sounded for decay; no deadwood, cavity or cracks on the load path
Design load = structure + occupant 100 kg, ×2.0 dynamic + canopy wind
Sling: vertical WLL ~1 t, rigged basket (≥ ~1.9 t); all metal ≥ 5:1 on design load
Continuous metal-to-metal chain D–E–F–G–H; bolt shackle pinned + split-pin
Base of mast is a sway-restraint only — branch grip carries 100% of vertical load
Re-seat / slacken sling every 1–2 seasons for radial (diameter) growth
Re-rate or replace textile annually (UV / abrasion); re-sound limb
